name: vLLM Priority
description: Prioritizes shared local/private vLLM requests by run-provenance urgency (foreground/normal/background) for one vLLM engine running --scheduling-policy priority.

providers.description: Provider ids (models.providers.<id>) this plugin claims for prepareExtraParams. OpenClaw resolves at most one provider plugin per provider id, so a provider id must be listed here for classification/injection to run for it at all.
